selection: Both memory arms use same deterministic AST-operation retrieval and identical complete successful source; no learned advice or stop instruction. Only representation of historical attempts differs.

primary_criteria.screen: Each repeat must protect aggregate quality, each task within original .02 absolute allowance, complete full correctness and <=5% cost regression; require original quality/cost benefit. Keep evaluator gates fixed.
primary_criteria.practical: Additionally >=10% relative quality improvement with <=5% wall/token overhead, or >=10% wall saving at protected quality and <=5% token overhead. Acquisition and selection costs explicitly separate; trial-only screening is not positive all-in return.
primary_criteria.analysis: Task-cluster bootstrap, all repeats together,10000 draws,seed8471; six exploratory outcome/reference comparisons use one-sided alpha .05/6. Development only, no final inference.
primary_criteria.failure: All attempts and unknown usage retained; incomplete pairing or missing usage forbids positive acceptance.

stop_rules: One frozen comparison, no automatic job/model retries and no further candidate resampling in this study
No final audit unless protected practical benefit; never use the prior audit set to tune selection
Prefer success-memory if complete episodes fail to beat it; do not keep complexity for its own sake
limitations: New formulas and sizes within two related operator families, not unseen families or production evidence
Deterministic episodic-memory prototype, not a reproduction of Meta-Harness/OpenEvolve and not proof of recursive capability improvement
Source matching is lexical AST similarity, not semantic equivalence; every new candidate still needs full evaluation
Old failed studies and their costs retained; no hypothetical amortization treated as observed gain
analysis_overhead: All prior training and developmental selection costs retained in total resource ledger; report incremental trial effects and all-in campaign cost separately, do not duplicate same-round validation in its own trials.
